about: The MCP suite's graphics test files on the real-GPU lane (docs/testing.md, 'The real-GPU lane'). gpu: runs on the lane's GPU. llvmpipe: compares with goldens drawn by llvmpipe; the MCP suite has no per-renderer goldens. other: stays on llvmpipe, for the reason given. A file not listed renders nothing that matters and stays on llvmpipe.
validated: run twice on H (RTX 3080 Ti, 1600x900 headless Xorg), BF16 2026-11-02; the nine it left failing, BF20 2026-11-03
